ammonia.reason: Deamination of amino acids by Penicillium roqueforti during 3-5 mo maturation releases NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol and indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism and traditional farm flora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin plus P. roqueforti proteinases concentrated in high-protein skim curd.

blue_moldy.reason: P. roqueforti beta-oxidation of fatty acids to 2-heptanone, 2-nonanone and 2-undecanone gives peppery blue.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine limited by low lactose and drained acidic curd.

buttery.reason: Skimmed milk limits milkfat; Lactococcus citrate metabolism gives modest diacetyl/acetoin and lactones.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: P. roqueforti lipase plus milk lipase release butanoic and hexanoic acids causing sweaty-cheesy pungency.

creaminess.reason: Low fat globules and reduced delta-decalactone/dodecalactone limit creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Low fat, low moisture and acidic loss of colloidal calcium phosphate fractures casein network.

firmness.reason: Skim milk low fat-in-dry-matter plus drier pressing and long maturation firms casein matrix.

floral_honey.reason: Limited phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol in drier skim matrix.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate from free fatty acids plus starter ethanol esterification.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine branched C8-C10 acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic; no goat character.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal and 2-methylbutanal from mold proteolysis give light nuttiness.

melt.reason: Reduced fat and dense casein with moderate salt limit fat coalescence and flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Mold lipoxygenase oxidation of linoleic acid to 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: Low total fat from hand-skimmed milk reduces free oil release; fat trapped in protein matrix.

smoky.reason: No smoking; no guaiacol/syringol phenols formed.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter lactic acid plus acetic acid from lactate metabolism by Penicillium.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata heating/kneading; rennet gel does not form aligned stretchable fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd from pasteurized milk; minimal methionine-derived H2S, DMS and methional.

sweet.reason: Lactose largely fermented; slight sweetness only from proline and free amino acids.

umami.reason: Glutamate/aspartate accumulation from rennet plus P. roqueforti proteolysis.
